heading: Daily board
subtitle: Everyone active on {{date}}, including the people with no record for the day — select them and mark the day in one go.
freezeExplanation: Attendance for a month freezes once that month's payroll has been processed — the figures have already been paid against. Marking is refused from that point, and the message you get back names what has to be undone in ERP → Payroll before the day can be edited.
dayLevelExplanation: This institute runs attendance in day-level mode: employees don't check in or out, so those columns are hidden. Change it under Shifts & Holidays → Configuration.
noSearchMatchDescription: Clear the search to see everyone active on this day.
noActiveEmployeesDescription: Attendance is taken against HR employee profiles. Add people under ERP → People first.
viewOnlyNote: You can review attendance but not change it — marking a day needs an HR Admin role in this institute.
markError: Could not mark attendance for this day.
